quests.title: Pressing Deadlines

dialogue.t: Oh boy, now I'm in trouble...

dialogue.sit: Clerk Zhao told me to give this to you...

dialogue.t: Huh? She needs a report of all the ships in the harbor!?
This... I actually had started keeping track of this at the very start...
But then there's also the imported goods report, the reports on crew information, and the customs report...
There's just sooo much to keep track of — report this, record that, I simply can't keep up with it all.

dialogue.sit: Hire some help...

dialogue.t: I want to, but it will take some time to find someone, so that won't help me finish the work at hand...

dialogue.sit: Just do this report that Clerk Zhao wants first.

dialogue.t: Hahaha! I don't even have enough time to remember all the information I need to report, let alone fill it out...

dialogue.sit: Do the most important reports first.

dialogue.t: Hmm... I think the reports are all of about equal importance.

dialogue.sit: There's no time...

dialogue.t: I know, so I'm trying my best now... I'll see if I can finish all the reports.

dialogue.sit: Just go and explain the situation...

dialogue.t: But I still have some time, I should just work harder to finish these reports...

dialogue.sit: I can help out.

dialogue.t: Thanks for the offer, but if you aren't familiar with the work you won't be much help.

dialogue.sit: Still going to put it off to later?

dialogue.t: I'll try to finish it on time, but as you can see I already have so much work to do, haha... It will be difficult to not put it off.

dialogue.sit: Then you need to figure it out yourself...

dialogue.t: I know, I know... This is my job, I can't rely on other people to do it for.

dialogue.sit: Prioritize your work better next time.

dialogue.t: Hahaha, I always tell myself I should, but I just get so busy that I forget to prioritize.
There's just too much work to do in the harbor. Too much.
Ugh... It's never a slow day at work, that's for sure...
There's still so much work, what should I do...?
I mean, you've seen how busy I am.
All of these different tasks to do at once, and all equally important.
Darn, looks like I'll simply have to put off this report to another time.
*sigh* I thought about it, but there's just not enough time... I have to work harder.
I'll burn the midnight oil tonight, and tomorrow, and the day after that... see if I can finish recording all the ships in the harbor.
After all, this was the very first report I started working on, so it shouldn't be the last one I submit.
No, that's not quite right either...

dialogue.sit: Clerk Zhao told me to give this to you...

dialogue.t: Hmm? About the plans for Lantern Rite...
Ah, I'm writing that right now. But it feels like it's missing something, so I keep editing it.
Everybody needs to do their very best for a big festival like Lantern Rite. So... I can't submit this plan just yet.

dialogue.sit: You're running out of time...

dialogue.t: I know I can come up with the best plan, I just need a bit more time...

dialogue.sit: Just submit it now.

dialogue.t: What!? I can't carelessly submit what amounts to a rough draft, this is Liyue's most important festival!

dialogue.sit: It will never be perfect.

dialogue.t: That may be true, but I should strive for perfection, no?

dialogue.sit: Any plan is better than no plan.

dialogue.t: That's true, but I shouldn't submit a plan that has something wrong with it, should I?

dialogue.sit: There's nothing wrong with your plan.

dialogue.t: Hmm, it may not have any glaring problems, but at least let me improve it even more.

dialogue.sit: Submit it first, you can change more later.

dialogue.t: Are you joking? Lantern Rite is a serious festival, there are procedures.

dialogue.sit: Get ideas from last year's plan...

dialogue.t: I've already been looking at last year's Lantern Rite. But... even though it was very popular among residents, I still think I can come up with something really special.

dialogue.sit: Be confident...

dialogue.t: What good is confidence if the people of Liyue don't like it?

dialogue.sit: Then... keep thinking?

dialogue.t: Yes! Give me a bit more time and I'll be able to write the perfect plan.
I have to give it my all for Lantern Rite. Think, Jiangzhou, think...
I have to come up with the very best plan...
No... The people of Liyue have been eagerly looking forward to Lantern Rite.
Nobody will be satisfied if it's just a touched-up version of last year's plan.
Don't try to stop me... I still need to make some changes, need to make the perfect plan...
Okay then... With a bit more time, I'll touch up the plan and fix some minor issues.
I'll submit it when I'm done touching it up.
I hope everyone really enjoys this year's Lantern Rite...
You're back. Thank you so much, Nervous An and Jiangzhou already sent me a message.
They said they will definitely submit their work on time.
Excellent... At the very least I can sleep well tonight...
Take these as thanks. You have really been a great help.
After this ordeal, I'm sure they won't repeat this kind of mistake again...
What? They still can't finish on time?
Another extension? Do they want to do this job or not?
Well, never mind. I suppose I'll have to find the time to chase them myself...
Oh, right. Take these, and thank you for your help.
You're back. Nervous An and Jiangzhou just sent me a message.
Only one of them promised they would submit their work on time, but I guess one is better than none.
As for the other one, I'll just have to continue to press them...
Regardless, I'm grateful for your help. Take these as thanks.

quests.description: Clerk Zhao is so swamped with work that she can’t even get a moment to herself. It seems she could use some assistance…
